cohort: The study included 1,894 Chinese women during their third trimester of pregnancy.
finding: After controlling for confounders, fear of childbirth was found to be a risk factor for caesarean sections in pregnant women.
mod_finding: Mild or high-level fear of childbirth during the third trimester was associated with an increased number of caesarean sections, with a stronger impact observed in multiparous women compared to primiparous women.
cross-section timing: During the third trimester of pregnancy
